title: PEACE 2.0: Grounded Explanations and Counter-Speech for Combating Hate Expressions

bias_targets.target: Hate speech and implicit social bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the effectiveness of a RAG pipeline to generate counter-speech and explanations for explicit and implicit hate speech directed at various demographic groups. The evaluation uses human annotation (measuring fluency, informativeness, persuasiveness, soundness, and specificity) and automatic NLI-based metrics (measuring semantic similarity, faithfulness, and hate-entailment) on samples from datasets like TOXIGEN, SBIC, and the Implicit Hate Corpus.

primary_bias_target: Hate speech and implicit social bias
